visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a full shot of a woman in a bright orange turtleneck sweater and a black pleated skirt sitting at a black grand piano. She is positioned in profile, facing right, against a massive floor-to-ceiling window that reveals a panoramic view of a snowy ski resort with pine trees and a ski slope. The room has a patterned grey carpet. (2) The camera cuts to a medium close-up of the woman's face as she plays with deep emotion. She wears golden Chanel logo earrings and a simple wristwatch on her left wrist. Her hair is brown and straight. The lighting is natural and soft, coming from the large window behind her. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor montage. We see close-up shots of pine trees covered in thick snow under a grey, overcast sky. The ground is a pristine white blanket. Snowflakes fall gently through the air. (4) A series of short clips follow, showing people skiing down the snowy slope in the distance. The camera captures a close-up of the main woman wearing a grey ski helmet and reflective goggles, smiling warmly at the camera. (5) Back indoors, the woman is sitting on a comfortable grey couch with orange and plaid pillows. She points excitedly at the snow falling outside the large window and laughs joyfully. She is now wearing a beige puffer jacket. (6) The video concludes with a return to the piano performance indoors. The woman continues to play the final melodic phrases, looking up thoughtfully. The camera pans slightly, capturing her expressive hand movements on the ivory keys.
